anime_a.description:
[Welcome to Murim Online, the world where the strongest reside.]
[Your device has malfunctioned, and logging out failed.]
[Would you like to attempt to disconnect once more?]
[Yes or No]
When he tried returning to virtual reality, the place he logged into was instead the “real Murim.” A once-in-an-era psychopath fell into the Murim due to the Grim Reaper’s mistake. Dong Bongsu's merciless fangs cast a shadow over Murim, which is rife with schemes and malice.(Source: Naver, translated)

anime_b.title_romaji: Tsuihou Sareta Tensei Juukishi wa Game Chishiki de Musou Suru
anime_b.title_english: Tsuihou Sareta Tensei Juukishi wa Game Chishiki de Musou Suru
anime_b.description:
Born into a prestigious family of master swordsmen, Elymas Edvaughn’s future shatters when he awakens the so-called “defective” Heavy Knight class. Disowned and cast out, he regains memories of another life—and realizes this world mirrors a VR game he once mastered. Armed with knowledge no one else possesses, he sets out to rewrite his fate and prove the strength of the “weakest” class.

(Source: Crunchyroll)
